Recovered full 16-page English Federal Law No. (7) of 2025 via official German NPPO JKI mirror and original Arabic PDF directly from Dubai Municipality. Article 4(1)(i) requires periodic measure reviews in line with international standards; 4(1)(o) concerns pest reporting/monitoring under ISPMs. Neither expressly adopts ISPM32 Category1 or supplies an automatic processed-food exemption. Article 1 retains the manufactured-product risk qualification; Article 5(2) certificate default remains conditional on scope. Corrected source title is Federal Law, not Federal Decree-Law.
